name: wordkeep
description: Personal lexicon with active recall, phrase grammar analysis, etymology, and cross-language word graphs

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.build:api: npx esbuild server/src/vercel-handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=api/index.js --packages=bundle --banner:js="import { createRequire as wordkeepRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = wordkeepRequire(import.meta.url);"
